summary: Skill code-review: high-effort pre-PR review (line-by-line + removed-behavior + cross-file). Found 2 CONFIRMED loop-crashing bugs — (1) create_pr ran gh pr create unconditionally even when the impl was not pushed (check=True -> ShikiError crashes the loop) and the already-committed runner case never pushed; (2) _evidence_relatives_for_task caught (OSError,ValueError) but read_json raises ShikiError on a non-dict ledger. Both fixed (push-if-ahead + create_pr stop_blocked guard + except Exception) and regression-tested. 0 findings remain.
